surfaceForm: University of Luxembourg / the University (recurring throughout)
location: main-body-EN.tex — passim (e.g. Sec. Summary for stakeholders L19; Sec. Reading guide L456; Sec. Introduction L691; Sec. NIS2 L1044; Sec. Specificities note L1631; Sec. Examples panel L2067; Sec. DPC applied L3581; Conclusion)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace named institution with a role-based placeholder denoting the adopting research-and-teaching university (the institution/the University).
rationale: The single largest barrier to institution-agnosticism. Used hundreds of times as the concrete subject of the whole report. Generic role: 'the adopting university'. Lower-case 'the University' can largely stay; the proper-noun form must be parameterized.

surfaceForm: uni.lu (domain, where present in citations/macros)
location: main-body-EN.tex — bib-driven references and email/domain mentions
proposedGenericDecision: Drop or parameterize any uni.lu domain reference to the institution's own domain.
rationale: Domain ties the document to one institution; only relevant where it appears literally (mostly via bib). Generic: 'the institution's domain'.

surfaceForm: Board of Governors / \institution{Board of Governors} / Conseil de Gouvernance
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. Summary for stakeholders (L26-27, L112, L159); Reading guide (L445, L648); Exec training (L3500); Transition (L3901, L3932)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the institution's top governing body.
rationale: 'Board of Governors' (fr. Conseil de Gouvernance) is the UL-specific statutory body name. Generic role: 'the institution's governing board'. Implicit governance-shape assumption that must be parameterized.

surfaceForm: Rectorate / Rector / president/rector / vice-president for teaching
location: main-body-EN.tex — Summary box (L22, L122, L162); Specificities/ISO clause5 (L2845-2846); Exec training (L3496); ICRADP reports to Rectorate (L4555, L4589)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the institution's central executive leadership.
rationale: Rectorate/Rector is a continental-European governance shape; many systems use President/Provost/Vice-Chancellor. Generic role: 'central executive leadership'.

surfaceForm: Faculty Council, University Council (as named institutional Bodies)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Summary box (L25, L117, L157-160); Reading guide (L444, L647); DPC decision path (L3541, L3587); Propositions
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based collegial-body terms for academic deliberative councils.
rationale: 'University Bodies (Faculty Council, University Council, Board of Governors)' is a UL-specific decision chain. Generic role: 'the academic deliberative councils and the governing board'.

surfaceForm: three faculties, each with departments of teaching and research, and interdisciplinary centres
location: main-body-EN.tex — Sec. DPC applied to UL (L3581-3588); Introduction (L691-696); Specificities note (L1631-1636)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise the organisational topology to 'faculties/schools, departments and research centres' without a fixed count.
rationale: Hard count 'three faculties' plus the specific UL split (research-only units / research-and-teaching departments / teaching-only components) is institution-specific. Generalise to a variable-count faculty/school structure; aligns with memory rule on avoiding hard self-counts.

surfaceForm: Department of Computer Science (DCS)
location: main-body-EN.tex — NIS2 letter notified to DCS (L568-569, L1067-1068); Advocacy Positions D (L1500, L1529); Cost pilot (L3842); Transition pilot (L3906, L3941)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term: 'a computer-science / cybersecurity-competent academic unit'.
rationale: DCS is a UL-named unit doing load-bearing work (recipient of the ILR letter; pilot site; basis of the 'knowledge-institution responsibility' argument). Generic role: 'the institution's computer-science department'.

surfaceForm: SnT / Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust
location: main-body-EN.tex — Cost pilot (L3843); Transition pilot (L3907, L3940)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term: 'a cybersecurity-focused interdisciplinary research centre'.
rationale: SnT is a UL-specific centre used as a concrete pilot site. Generic role: 'a security/reliability research centre'.

surfaceForm: ULHPC / the university's HPC team / MeluXina (EuroHPC)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux SDMZ status (L2726, L2734, L2745-2746); Cost pilot (L3843); Transition pilot (L3908, L3941)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace ULHPC with 'the institution's HPC facility/team'; MeluXina with 'the national/regional EuroHPC supercomputer'.
rationale: ULHPC and MeluXina are Luxembourg-specific named facilities. Generic roles: 'the institution's HPC facility' and 'the national EuroHPC system'.

surfaceForm: ILR / Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation (national NIS2 supervisory authority)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Summary box (L52); NIS2 (L1041-1044, L1117); Lux landscape (L569, L1277); Advocacy (L1424, L1506, L1530, L1538, L1555); Obligations tables; Propositions (L4048, L4120); Transition (L3887, L3925)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the national NIS2 supervisory authority.
rationale: ILR is the Luxembourg NIS2 competent authority; every Member State designates its own. Generic role: 'the national NIS2 supervisory authority'.

surfaceForm: GOVCERT.LU (governmental CSIRT)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux context (L573-574, L1122-1128); Shared security orgs (L3733, L3744, L3747)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the national/governmental CSIRT applicable to the public sector.
rationale: GOVCERT.LU is Luxembourg's governmental CSIRT. Generic role: 'the national governmental CSIRT for public-sector entities'.

surfaceForm: HCPN (Haut-Commissariat à la Protection nationale)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux context (L574, L1124, L1127); SERIMA (L1149); MONARC (LHoC); Shared security orgs
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the national point-of-contact / national-protection authority hosting the CSIRT.
rationale: HCPN is Luxembourg's NIS2 single point of contact and host of GOVCERT.LU/ANSSI-LU. Generic role: 'the national cyber single-point-of-contact authority'.

surfaceForm: ANSSI Luxembourg / ANSSI-LU (national Agency for Information Systems Security)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux context (L575, L1128, L1189-1192); Advocacy D (L1506, L1531); PSI-LU authorship
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the national information-security agency authoring the state IS policy.
rationale: ANSSI-LU is Luxembourg-specific (explicitly distinguished from the French ANSSI). Generic role: 'the national information-security agency'.

surfaceForm: CNPD (Luxembourg data-protection authority)
location: main-body-EN.tex — SERIMA partners (L1149); Safeguards-AI advocacy (L3112); Advocacy D.5 (L1555)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the national data-protection authority.
rationale: CNPD is Luxembourg's DPA; every Member State has its own. Generic role: 'the national data-protection authority'.

surfaceForm: CIRCL (CSIRT for private sector / communes / NGOs)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux landscape ecosystem disambiguation (L1135-1137); Shared security orgs (L3740-3744)
proposedGenericDecision: Drop or parameterize; this is a Luxembourg ecosystem-disambiguation detail with no generic counterpart guaranteed.
rationale: CIRCL is Luxembourg-specific; included only to disambiguate which CSIRT is first-line. Generic role: 'the national private-sector CSIRT, where one exists'. Could be dropped if no analogue.

surfaceForm: CSSF (financial-sector supervisor)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux landscape disambiguation (L1138-1140)
proposedGenericDecision: Drop; Luxembourg-specific financial supervisor noted only to exclude it from scope.
rationale: CSSF is a Luxembourg financial regulator mentioned only to say it is NOT competent for the university; not needed in an institution-agnostic version.

surfaceForm: SERIMA national incident-notification platform (operational since 2 May 2025)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux context (L578-584, L1144-1154); MONARC (L2927); Obligations tables (L1282, L1289); Reg summary (L1368); Transition steps 0/4 (L3889, L3926)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for the national NIS2 incident-notification/risk-analysis platform; drop the launch date.
rationale: SERIMA is Luxembourg's single national platform; the binding cadence (24h/72h/30d) is generic NIS2 Art.23 and can stay. Generic role: 'the national incident-notification platform'.

surfaceForm: NCSS III (National Cybersecurity Strategy III, 2018), Implementation Objective 7
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux context (L585-592, L1156-1165); Advocacy C.4 (L1495); Methodology note (L995)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based reference to the national cybersecurity strategy's academic-cooperation objective.
rationale: NCSS III + 'Objective 7 academic cooperation' is a Luxembourg-specific political hook. Generic role: 'the national cybersecurity strategy and its research-cooperation objective'.

surfaceForm: Project of law 8364 (PL 8364) — Luxembourg NIS2 transposition; and PL 8307 (CER transposition)
location: main-body-EN.tex — passim: Summary (L50); Reading guide (L466); NIS2 (L1051-1071); Lux landscape (L1169-1176); Obligations tables; Advocacy A-D; Propositions; Transition; many \cite{pl-8364}/\cite{pl-8307-cer}
proposedGenericDecision: Replace specific bill numbers/articles with role-based reference to 'the national NIS2 transposition (and its equivalents to NIS2 Articles 21/23/20/12)'.
rationale: PL 8364/8307 and their internal article numbering (Art.2(34°), 11(1)(4°), 2(40°), 12(1)(2)(3)) are Luxembourg-jurisdiction-bound. The underlying EU NIS2/CER articles are generic and can be cited directly. Generic role: 'the national NIS2 transposition law'. Note implicit national-transposition assumption is stated as binding.

surfaceForm: PSI-LU (Politique générale de la sécurité de l'information de l'État luxembourgeois), approved 13 July 2018
location: main-body-EN.tex — Methodology note (L994); Lux landscape public-sector reference (L1184-1198)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based reference to the national public-sector information-security baseline policy.
rationale: PSI-LU is the Luxembourg state IS policy that the architecture is positioned as 'compatible with'. Generic role: 'the national public-sector information-security baseline'.

surfaceForm: Luxembourg Law of 28 November 2006 (transposing Directive 2000/78/EC)
location: main-body-EN.tex — ICRADP legal foundations (L4187-4189)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based reference to 'the national transposition of Directive 2000/78/EC into labour law'.
rationale: Named national statute; the EU Directive 2000/78/EC and CRPD references are generic and stay. Generic role: 'the national anti-discrimination/labour transposition'.

surfaceForm: 'standard practice of administrative review under Luxembourg public law'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Advocacy C.3 (L1471-1484)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'the applicable national administrative-review framework'.
rationale: Explicit jurisdiction-bound claim about Luxembourg public law. Generic role: 'national administrative law of the adopting jurisdiction'.

surfaceForm: RESTENA (Luxembourg NREN) — and RESTENA-CSIRT
location: main-body-EN.tex — Academic domain (L497-500); Examples panel (L2054-2057); NREN ecosystem (L2661); Lux SDMZ status (L2726-2782); Shared security orgs (L3736, L3747); Propositions P10 (L4098); architecture figure label (L3232)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for 'the institution's national research-and-education network (NREN) and its CSIRT'.
rationale: RESTENA is the Luxembourg NREN; GEANT/eduroam/eduGAIN are pan-European and stay generic. The federated-research-zone reframing (UL/LIST/LIH via RESTENA) is wholly Luxembourg-specific. Generic role: 'the national NREN'.

surfaceForm: LIST (Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology) and LIH (Luxembourg Institute of Health)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Lux SDMZ status: mutualised Science DMZ (L2762-2782)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term for 'peer national research-active institutions sharing the NREN'.
rationale: LIST/LIH are the Luxembourg public research institutes invoked to justify a mutualised national Science DMZ. Generic role: 'other research-active institutions on the same NREN'. The whole 'too small for three Science DMZs' argument is Luxembourg-scale-bound.

surfaceForm: 'In a country that is among the wealthiest in the world' / 'university's multi-year agreement with the State' / 'multi-year plan with the State'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Justification & Feasibility (L3757-3775); Summary feasibility (L128-135); Cost analysis
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'within the institution's multi-year planning and funding framework'; drop the wealth claim or make it role-neutral.
rationale: Implicit Luxembourg-specific framing: national wealth and the UL 'four-year convention pluriannuelle with the State'. Generic role: 'the institution's multi-year funding agreement'.

surfaceForm: Université Paris-Saclay ransomware (August 2024); ANSSI (French) cooperation
location: main-body-EN.tex — Summary (L62); Central IT msg (L255); Failures France (L2490-2503); root-cause table (L2582, L2586); ANSSI-LU disambiguation note (L1191)
proposedGenericDecision: Keep as an external, publicly-documented case study; it is not part of the adopting institution. Retain as evidence but ensure framing is third-party.
rationale: Named external incidents (Paris-Saclay, Rennes, Sorbonne, Texas Tech, Western Sydney, MOVEit, Oracle EBS, Howard) are evidentiary case studies about OTHER institutions, not about the adopting one — they do not bind the document to a single institution and should generally be kept. Flagged for review only because the French ANSSI is referenced; the UL-specific ANSSI-LU/ANSSI disambiguation note becomes unnecessary once ANSSI-LU is parameterized.

surfaceForm: Université de Rennes (March 2025); Sorbonne Université (2024)
location: main-body-EN.tex — Failures France (L2504-2515)
proposedGenericDecision: Keep as external case studies (third-party institutions).
rationale: External incident evidence; not the adopting institution. Keep — but note these are French-system examples; an institution-agnostic suite may wish to diversify the incident panel across jurisdictions (review, not mandatory).

surfaceForm: 'sanctions up to EUR 10 M or 2% of annual turnover'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Reading guide / European regulatory landscape (L528-529)
proposedGenericDecision: Keep — this is the generic NIS2 essential-entity sanction ceiling, not a Luxembourg-specific figure.
rationale: The EUR 10M / 2% turnover figure is the EU NIS2 Directive ceiling applicable across all Member States; it is not jurisdiction-bound and need not be parameterized.

surfaceForm: \institution{...} semantic macro used for UL bodies (Board of Governors, ILR, CNPD, Luxembourg House of Cybersecurity, ULHPC, MeluXina, LIST, LIH, EPFL, CERN, etc.)
proposedGenericDecision: Audit every \institution{} argument: those naming UL-bound bodies must route through localization variables; generic peer-institution names (MIT, Oxford, CERN, EPFL) may stay as comparators.
rationale: Read-for-meaning: the \institution{} macro is content-neutral but wraps a mix of (a) UL/Luxembourg bodies that must be parameterized and (b) external comparator universities that should be kept. Each argument needs individual classification; the macro itself is fine.

surfaceForm: University of Luxembourg Committee for Reasonable Adjustments (existing internal body) and 'the precedent of the University of Luxembourg'
location: main-body-EN.tex — ICRADP section (L4499-4522)
proposedGenericDecision: Replace with role-based term: 'the institution's existing reasonable-adjustments committee, where one exists', and reframe as a generic coherence argument.
rationale: The 'the university already has X, so extend it' argument is built on a UL-specific existing body. Generic role: 'an existing student/staff reasonable-adjustments committee'. Must be conditionalised for institutions that lack one.

surfaceForm: ICRADP (fr: CARPN) — Independent Commission for Reasonable Adjustments of Digital Policies; \gls{icradp}
location: main-body-EN.tex — Summary (L100-101); Stakeholder boxes (L334, L427); ICRADP section title and body (L4524, L4528, L4706-4711)
proposedGenericDecision: Keep the English acronym/body as a proposed generic instrument; drop the French 'CARPN' gloss, which presumes a French-language institution.
rationale: ICRADP is a generic proposed governance body and can stay; the parenthetical French acronym 'CARPN' assumes a French-speaking institution and should be dropped or parameterized to the local-language acronym.

surfaceForm: French-language body names embedded in prose (Conseil de Gouvernance; Politique générale de la sécurité de l'information de l'État luxembourgeois; Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation; CARPN)
proposedGenericDecision: Remove French-language institutional glosses or route through localization variables; the document is otherwise English.
rationale: Embedded French names presume a Francophone jurisdiction and reinforce Luxembourg binding even where the English term is parameterized. Read-for-meaning flag distinct from the body names themselves.

surfaceForm: 'EPFL (~12000 students, comparable to the University of Luxembourg)' and 'The University of Luxembourg has more than two decades of experience'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Examples reference-panel selection criteria (L2058-2069)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise the panel-selection rationale so size/track-record comparisons reference 'the adopting institution' rather than UL specifically.
rationale: The comparator panel is justified by explicit size/age comparison to UL (~12k students, two decades). The peer-institution list (MIT, Stanford, Cambridge, ETH, CERN, EPFL, Oxford, Michigan, etc.) is generic and stays; only the UL-anchored comparison clauses need generalising.

surfaceForm: 'campus perimeter' / 'campus network core' / 'on-campus' singular-campus framing
location: main-body-EN.tex — Science DMZ principles (L1715); BYOD msg (L370, L411); architecture figure 'Campus network core' (L3234); Conceptual layers (L3152)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'campus/site perimeter(s)' to avoid presuming a single campus or single data-centre topology.
rationale: Read-for-meaning: language assumes one campus / one network core. Some peers cited (CERN Meyrin/Prevessin; Michigan Ann Arbor/Dearborn/Flint) are explicitly multi-site, so the prose should not presume a single campus. Low confidence because 'campus' is also generic IT vocabulary; flagged for reviewer judgement.

surfaceForm: 'classified by the ILR as an essential entity on the basis of its status as a public institution' + the three cumulative legal pegs + 'letter notified to DCS on 3 April 2026'
location: main-body-EN.tex — Summary (L49-55); NIS2 (L1041-1071); Lux context (L560-569); Advocacy B.1/C.1/C.3 (L1419-1484)
proposedGenericDecision: Generalise to 'where the institution is classified as a NIS2 essential (or important) entity under the national transposition'; drop the dated letter and UL-specific pegs.
rationale: The entire essential-entity classification narrative is Luxembourg-jurisdiction-bound (specific authority, specific bill articles, specific notification date). An institution-agnostic version must treat classification as a parameter (essential vs important; the determining national criteria), not a fixed UL fact.

surfaceForm: Concrete jurisdiction-bound dates: '3 April 2026' (ILR letter), '2 May 2025' (SERIMA), '13 July 2018' (PSI-LU), '26 January 2018' (NCSS III), '1 September 2023' (PL 8307)
proposedGenericDecision: Drop the specific national dates that anchor the document to Luxembourg's regulatory timeline; retain only generic EU-level dates (e.g. NIS2 applicable since 17 Oct 2024).
rationale: These dates are specific to Luxembourg instruments/notifications and reinforce institution/jurisdiction binding. EU-instrument dates (GDPR 2018, NIS2 2024, AI Act 2024) are generic and stay.
